title: The basics
blurb: Windows, typing, the leader key and help. From zero.

greet: Hi, I am Tilly. We start from zero, one key at a time.
Hello. I live in a terminal too. Let us open your first window.
finish: That is the basics. You can drive tuios now.
Windows, modes, the leader key and help. All yours.

steps.title: Open a window
steps.note: You start in window mode. Keys move windows.
steps.hint: Press n. You start in window mode, where n opens a window.

web.hint: Click the dark area first, then press n.

steps.title: Start typing in it
steps.note: i flips to typing mode. Watch the badge.
steps.hint: Press i. The badge turns green and says TYPING.

steps.title: Say hi to the shell
steps.note: Your keys go to the program now.

steps.title: Split with the leader key
steps.note: ctrl+b, let go, then a key. It works in any mode.
steps.hint: Hold ctrl, tap b, let go. A menu pops up. Now press | (shift and backslash).

steps.title: Back to window mode
steps.note: ctrl+b, then esc. The badge flips back.

steps.title: Hop between windows
steps.hint: In window mode, tab moves to the next window.

steps.title: Close one
steps.hint: In window mode, x closes the window with the bright border.

steps.title: Every key, one page
steps.note: Forgot a key? It is in here.
steps.hint: Press ? to open help. Look around, then esc to close it.

steps.title: Or just search for it
steps.note: The command palette runs anything by name.
steps.hint: ctrl+p opens the palette. Type zoom and press enter.
